# Installation process fixtures

These controlled fixtures exercise the actual Installation process collaborator
and its selected Kubernetes Driver factory. They preserve original create-effect
identity, exact object/container ancestry, independent cleanup responsibility and
unknown outcomes across cancellation or late effects.

Supplied control-plane observations, deletion acknowledgments and host close do
not establish physical process-tree termination. A replacement disposition needs
its original authenticated process-settlement source, including late-create
closure. Controlled peers provide no production authority or runtime qualification.

The suite uses the selected Driver's cached participant and request wrapper with
the official Kubernetes SDK serializers and a controlled transport. Its private
fixture peers model exact call enrollment, atomic submission tickets and current
cleanup responsibility; they are never selected by production configuration.
It exercises call replay, deadline and synchronous-fence failures, concurrent
creates, delayed acknowledgments, complete and partial descendant lists, fixed
container selection, and UID/resourceVersion deletion conditions.

With the repository's genuine dependencies and composed Gateway startup contract
export prepared, run the focused suite with
`node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/conformance/kubernetes-installation-process.test.mjs`.
The adjacent `tsconfig.json` checks the actual public contract, Driver factory and
all three collaborators under strict TypeScript settings. Neither command invokes
a Kubernetes cluster or tests a physical process observer.
